hypothesis: Run-2 board execution of the workload registered in spec/r41/stage2/board/s2-hbm8.json passes its explicit numerical and structural checks on the approved 100 MHz image.
competing_explanations: the run-2 image, its striped HBM layout, or its four-context DP profile changes behavior
a workload fails, falls back, times out, or is omitted from its registered checks
the card identity or clock changes during the run
expected_counter_changes: outlet read/write line deltas on all three outlets for the probe kernels
each launch issues and completes programs on all three cores (peak_active 3)
stream: outlet read lines x 64 B >= the 2.25 GiB storage for one row reduction
R_AXI_STAT error/stray bits stay clear after every case
expected_observations: the registered workload completes with its numerical and structural checks passing on run-2
the experiment records the observed image, clock, software tree and raw results

board.load_policy: approved run-2 image after 15 consecutive idle minutes; every FPGA step checks identity

registration.source_scope: frozen image source separately verified; runtime tree recorded by experiment.py
inherited_expected_observations: window: 8 GiB XRT BO in MBG[0:31], R_AXI_BASE/SIZE/STAT readback, heap = window, PC0-PC31 contiguous
negatives: allocator/host/MMIO refusals at the 8 GiB end, host window last word, reserved TMU page
samples: 34 probes: every PC boundary, both BO edges, virtual 4 GiB; DMA in, 3-core device add, DMA out
alias: bit 30/31/32/32+31 address pairs and TMU page + 2/4/6 GiB: distinct device load/store values
crossing: device store-load across virtual 4 GiB, physical 4 GiB and the window end; DMA out and in
dma: 256 MiB DMA in at the window top, device copy to 6 GiB, 2 x 256 MiB DMA out
clamp: hbm_bytes 16 GiB exposes exactly the 8 GiB group

inherited_registration.order: as listed; one process per case
inherited_registration.xclbin_map: evidence/r41/stage2/board/xclbin_hbm_map.json: identical HBM topology, group connectivity and 4/8 GiB allocation to the B40 map
